Thanks Eva — good data and helpful context. Quick read-through and initial notes below (we'll expand in the checkpoint on 4/3). Quoting your numbers where useful.

Summary of our quick internal analysis (RW-V2-xl on hosted):
- Baseline p50/p95 (end-to-end): ~180ms / 980ms when KV cache hits > 60%
- Your reported p50/p95 (210ms / 1.12s) align with cache miss windows and longer seq loads
- Throughput: 1,100 tokens/s observed — good headroom on dedicated nodes, but matters if you need consistent 99th percentile latency
- Tails (2.3s): correlate with sequence lengths >= 2k and tokenization spikes (multi-turn context)

Proposed immediate tuning (short list for this week):
1) Enable prefix/KV caching at session-level for high-reuse flows (Owner: rishi_malhotra)
2) Add small model fallback for latency-sensitive routes (rw-v2-large) and prepare canary image (Owner: tessa_morgan)
3) Adjust batch_max_tokens from 4096 -> 3072 for chat-short routes to lower p95 (Owner: neha_kapoor)
4) Run targeted load with 75/25 distribution of short/long contexts to reproduce 2.3s tails (Owner: rishi_malhotra)

Folks — quick technical plan to reproduce and tune the observed tails. Keeping it short:

Experiment 1 — KV cache coverage
- Rationale: cache hit % was low for multi-turn demo flows; increasing session affinity and pre-warming should reduce p95
- Run: synthetic traffic with session stickiness for 10k unique sessions vs 1k repeated sessions
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95/99, cache hit %, tokens/sec, CPU/GPU utilization per pod
- Timeline: start 4/04, results by 4/06 (Owner: rishi_malhotra)

Experiment 2 — Batch sizing and seq-len splits
- Rationale: longer sequences increase KV lookups and can blow up latency tails when batched indiscriminately
- Run: split workload into short (<=512 tokens) and long (>512) and enforce separate batch windows; measure end-to-end p95
- Timeline: run 4/05-4/06 (Owner: neha_kapoor / infra)

Experiment 3 — Canary fallback config
- Rationale: prepare rw-v2-large as an automatic fallback for the 5% highest-latency requests
- Plan: create canary image with lower mem/compute footprint, smoke test, validation harness, and automated rollback on error rate > 0.5%
- Timeline: canary ready for smoke 4/07; canary run 4/08-4/09 (Owner: tessa_morgan + ops)

Notes:
- I pushed a short run log to the Drive link in the MAP (drive id in related_links).
- We'll need Nexa to provide two representative prompt templates for the short/long splits (Eva — can you share?)

Rishi
